title: Chapter 173: The Silkworm Project
content:
Chapter 173: The Silkworm Project

If the Zerg want to become famous in the native camp, it is definitely not enough to fight on the front line. The speed of information dissemination in this world is not fast, and some other means are needed.

Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg, through analyzing the known information of this world, combined with Wu Qing's various ideas, used the biotechnology of the Zerg and Wu Qing's understanding of the essence of cultivation, and finally formulated a long-term plan called "Tiancan Plan".

The Zerg mother nest was upgraded to three stars, evolved to the beast cave form, and unlocked more powerful biotechnology, which made the conditions for the implementation of this plan initially met.

The carefully optimized Zerg and Zerg warhorse are only part of this plan.

Wu Qing has some understanding of the cultivation system of this world through various channels, especially after the human wanderers led by Wu Cong joined, their original strength was not weak, and the cultivation methods were strange and varied, which has very good reference value.

The essence of cultivation in this world remains the same despite all the changes.

Cultivating physical strength, cultivating various energies, and cultivating spiritual strength, putting aside the external and looking at the essence, it is actually the set of essence, qi, and spirit that Wu Qing is familiar with.

The cultivation in this world is more difficult, and the improvement of strength across star levels also requires the support of luck.

Therefore, it is not easy to cultivate a strong person in this world, and it takes a lot of time and resources.

If you don't take shortcuts and cultivate talents according to the methods of this world, this cycle will be very long.

It is precisely because of this that the large-scale wars in this world are mainly caused by ordinary soldiers who are not included in the stars. These ordinary soldiers can be formed into an army with just a little training, which is a cheap source of troops.

The real powerful soldiers consume a lot of resources and are cultivated after long-term training. They are only used as core forces.

Wu Qing is facing this situation now. If you want to develop both the light and dark territories together, you must have a shortcut to quickly improve your strength. Otherwise, no matter how hard the Great Xia Territory develops, it can't keep up with the development speed of the Zerg.

Wu Qing's open power development in this world can no longer be limited to conventional methods. It must be more radical. Use the advantages of the Zerg to quickly improve your strength and increase your influence.

The "Heavenly Silkworm Project" aims to quickly improve the strength of Daxia Territory and the influence of the Zerg by solving the problem that the individual strength of this world cannot be improved quickly.

And improve the strength of the local camp within a controllable range, and strengthen the ability of the local camp to fight against the evil god camp.

This is an extremely large plan that cannot be completed overnight. It needs to be implemented and improved step by step in order to achieve the desired effect.

The preparation work of this plan alone is very complicated.

Zergmen and Zerg war horses are the execution tools of this plan. Only with them can this plan be implemented.

A large number of Zergmen and Zerg war horses are one of the prerequisites.

The real core part of the "Heavenly Silkworm Project" is the cultivation method named Tiancan Jiubian by Wu Qing, and the Zerg creature Tiancan that assists in the cultivation of Tiancan Jiubian.

The Tiancan Jiubian method is an extremely special cultivation method created by Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg, combining the cultivation method of this world and using the biotechnology of the Zerg.

The core of this method is the Zerg creature named Tiancan by Wu Qing.

The Heavenly Silkworm was a Zerg creature that the Queen began to research when the "Heavenly Silkworm Project" was launched, but due to the limitations of the original Zerg biotechnology, it has never been successful.

It was not until the mother nest evolved into the beast cave form and the Zerg unlocked stronger biotechnology that the Queen was able to successfully develop the Heavenly Silkworm, a Zerg creature that meets the requirements of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations cultivation method after a lot of research and experiments.

The Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations is a method that assists other creatures in cultivation based on this Zerg creature.

To practice the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations, you must let the Heavenly Silkworm parasitize in your body, and the two sides form a mutually beneficial symbiotic relationship.

This kind of practice that relies on parasites to practice is very common in this world and is not surprising. Many of the two thousand human wanderers in Daxia Territory practice this kind of practice.

The parasites in their bodies are all kinds of strange, and the various techniques are simply mind-blowing, which greatly expanded Wu Qing's thinking. His idea of creating the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations was inspired by this kind of practice.

The silkworm needs to enter other organisms to parasitize, so Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects designed it to look like a crystal clear little silkworm baby, which looks pure and cute, which will greatly reduce the resistance of other organisms.

In the non-parasitic state, the silkworm will also secrete a transparent beeswax to seal itself, like a transparent small pill.

When the silkworm enters other organisms, as long as the parasitized organism practices the Silkworm Nine Transformations, the silkworm can use the body of the parasite to absorb external energy and start to grow.

During the growth of the silkworm, it will continuously optimize the genes of the parasite at the genetic level, so that the bodies of various parasites will evolve in a direction that is conducive to absorbing external energy and accelerating the speed of cultivation, which is equivalent to changing the cultivation qualifications of the parasite in a disguised way.

This is an ability achieved by relying on the powerful biotechnology of the Zerg. This ability is a very heaven-defying ability in this world.

In order to prevent others from deserting their relationship after gaining benefits, the Celestial Silkworm will only need to leave the body of the parasite and the parasite will end its symbiotic relationship with the Celestial Silkworm. This genetic evolution will be reversed and a large part of the energy and luck in the parasite's body will be sucked away.

To outsiders, this is the price of abolishing the practice, which is no different from other practices.

Practicing the Nine Changes of the Silkworm is just an ordinary practice without the assistance of the silkworm. When it is assisted by the silkworm, it can change its own qualifications and quickly improve its strength.

Even if you just practice hard, you can achieve multiple obvious improvements in strength in one day. In the extreme state, it can reach the level of nine obvious improvements.

If you use the luck beads and energy coins to practice, this effect will be more obvious. As long as the energy and luck are sufficient, nine changes a day is not a problem.

And this set of skills is more suitable for battlefield fighting. On the battlefield, there is no upper limit to the improvement of this set of skills. As long as you kill the enemy, you can quickly improve your own strength, so that you can quickly cultivate a large number of strong people on the battlefield.

Another meaning of the nine changes of the silkworm is that the silkworm will undergo nine transformations during its growth process. Each time they transform, the star level of the parasite is improved.

In theory, after nine growth and transformations of the silkworm, the strength of the parasite can be improved to nine stars.

This is a set of skills with a very high upper limit!

The silkworm has a certain spirituality. The nine changes of the silkworm can be cultivated and the corresponding combat skills can be inherited by parasites through spiritual communication with the symbiotic silkworm. It is very magical.

The silkworm is a Zerg creature with all the characteristics of the Zerg. It can connect to the Zerg network. The Zerg has a very large space for operation, but except for the normal functions that conform to the common sense of this world, other abilities will not be used unless in special circumstances.

After many optimizations, the magical silkworm of the Zerg can now consume 1000 energy and one larva, and can hatch 1000, that is, the resource consumption is 1 energy.

1 energy allows the silkworm to maintain its form and carry the basic gene library. More things are obtained through the Zerg network and parasites after they successfully parasitize and form a symbiotic relationship with parasites.

The process of obtaining these things is the process of its growth.

Once this kind of thing that conforms to the common sense of this world and the interests of Wu Qing and the Zerg comes out, it will definitely cause a big storm.

The Nine Transformations of Heavenly Silkworm and Heavenly Silkworm are nothing to Wu Qing and the Zerg, but they are very precious to the creatures of this world. Wu Qing dare not underestimate their value like the Zerg energy coins.

If this technique is really popularized, it will have a huge impact on this world, so this "Heavenly Silkworm Plan" needs to be implemented step by step and cannot be rushed.

Wu Qing needs to promote the implementation of the "Heavenly Silkworm Plan" according to the development speed of the Zerg.

…

The "Heavenly Silkworm Plan" must first be implemented in Daxia Territory. The human army of Daxia Territory led by Wu Cong can choose the Nine Transformations of Heavenly Silkworm if they want to change their cultivation techniques.

Their current strength has fallen to the bottom, and it is very convenient to change the techniques. Moreover, many of them are practicing ordinary techniques that are used to practice. Now that there are high-level cultivation techniques provided by large tribes such as the Zerg, most people are willing to switch to cultivation.

This is the first group of people in this world who have the opportunity to practice the Nine Transformations of Heavenly Silkworm. The second group of people are the people in Daxia Territory who are interested in the army.

Because there are not many real free people in Daxia Territory now, this group of people is very small, and they are all young people of warlike races. Wu Qing is ready to give them a chance.

By practicing the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworm, they have the capital to join the army of Daxia Territory. As long as they are willing to work hard, it will not be a problem to join the army of Daxia Territory in the future.

Without this opportunity, ordinary people may not meet the requirements of the army of Daxia Territory even if they work hard all their lives.

The third group of people are the armies of various territories of the alliance. As long as the lords of various territories pay a certain price, Wu Qing can provide a batch of heavenly silkworms for various territories of the alliance, so that the army of the alliance can switch to the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworm.

The reason for charging is also a way to eliminate other people's vigilance. If you give precious things to others for free, others may suspect that you have ulterior motives.

As long as the alliance army that switches to the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworm works hard and participates in some battles, its strength will increase very quickly, and the gap with other armies will soon appear.
